 Event
 Composers Collective
 Featuring student work, the concert is an open call to all composers in the Department, showcasing the diverse compositional voices within our programs. 
 The Composers Collective Fall concert showcases the creative diversity of our undergraduate composition majors. The performance offers a platform for music artists across a variety of genres to share their creations in an evening of chamber music, solo pieces, film scores, and songs. 
 Admission is free. Registration is required.
